subject: Cannabinoid receptor 2 activation locks breast cancer cells into a differentiated, therapy-sensitive state
script: From Agewell Brief: Cannabinoid receptor 2 activation locks breast cancer cells into a differentiated, therapy-sensitive state. Brief, low-dose CB2R agonists trigger an epigenetic switch that curbs plasticity and boosts tamoxifen response in organoid models. CB2R activation induces basal-to-luminal transition, reducing self-renewal and invasiveness. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
